import os,subprocess,json,hashlib,base64,sys,time,re
from pathlib import Path
w=Path.cwd();run=Path(os.environ.get("LEAN")or os.environ["LAKE_OVERRIDE_LEAN"]).parents[2]
owner=w/"Aglib/AlgebraicGeometry/EtaleCohomology/Kummer/SectionPullback.lean"
assert hashlib.sha256(owner.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=="e03cfe26fda95e308601af1d0e94e8492397640275a860d215af4e5d2e3d68e1"
blob=base64.b64decode('')
assert hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()=='b9a6aac2e8befd8d83b22d31ba2014a6691351f320ab89300eba4e4e87a9c884'
assert re.findall(r"^public import (.*)$",blob.decode(),re.M)==re.findall(r"^public import (.*)$",owner.read_text(),re.M)
source=run/"RootsSectionFormation.lean";source.write_bytes(blob)
p=subprocess.run([os.environ["LAKE"],"--no-build","setup-file",str(owner)],text=True,capture_output=True)
(run/"ACTUAL-NATIVE-SETUP.stderr.log").write_text(p.stderr)
if p.returncode:print(p.stdout+p.stderr,flush=True);sys.exit(p.returncode)
setup=json.loads(p.stdout);assert setup["name"]=="Aglib.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleCohomology.Kummer.SectionPullback" and setup["isModule"] is True
sp=run/"ACTUAL-NATIVE-SETUP.json";sp.write_text(json.dumps(setup,indent=2)+"\n")
print("ROOTS_FORMATION_SETUP "+json.dumps({"name":setup["name"],"isModule":setup["isModule"],"options":setup["options"],"setup_sha256":hashlib.sha256(sp.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"source_sha256":'b9a6aac2e8befd8d83b22d31ba2014a6691351f320ab89300eba4e4e87a9c884',"meaning":"Three exact original propositions as (_h:P):True; no original proof."}),flush=True)
cmd=[os.environ["LEAN"],str(source),"--setup",str(sp),"--json","-j4","-M12800","-o",str(run/"RootsSectionFormation.olean"),"-i",str(run/"RootsSectionFormation.ilean")]
print("ROOTS_FORMATION_COMMAND "+json.dumps(cmd),flush=True);start=time.monotonic();r=subprocess.run(cmd);print("ROOTS_FORMATION_RESULT "+json.dumps({"exit":r.returncode,"wall_seconds":time.monotonic()-start,"P_proved":False}),flush=True);sys.exit(r.returncode)
